_: The About page (/about): who Phiegg is, as a run of screens. Every word and picture is here; the page loops. `hero` is the first screen, `band` the parts (picture and words side by side, sides alternating), `figure` the counts (`count` is a path into the data whose length is shown), `coin` the coins (how they move, then the `shown` most held club coins), `closing` the last screen. Pictures are the Phi stage renders (scripts/media/home-pictures.json, set `about`). A `tab` is the path a button opens.

hero.title: Where virtual worlds get dressed.
hero.body: Our mission is to give every club a world of its own, and everyone in it something to wear, make and trade.

band.title: Stage
band.body: Every world walks its own show. Looks go from the runway to the feed, and from the feed to the people who wear them.

band.title: Worlds
band.body: A club starts as a nest and grows into a city: zones to walk, places to meet, hosts to join.

band.title: Hosts
band.body: A host is where a club gathers. What you hold decides what you can open, with no roles to hand out by hand.

band.title: Makers
band.body: Creators publish looks, rides and gems as PFTs. Every sale, quest and show pays the people who made it.

coin.title: Coins
coin.body: Coins are how thanks, tickets and trades move on Phiegg. Every club has its own; PHI is the platform's.

step.title: Get
step.body: Top up with PHI, or pick up a club's coin in its pool.

step.title: Give
step.body: Send coins to a creator on a shot, a show or a cast you liked.

step.title: Earn
step.body: Quests, sales and front rows pay out in the club's coin.

step.title: Swap
step.body: Trade one club's coin for another in the pools, at the live price.

closing.title: Hatch your club.
closing.body: Go direct or through Phipad. Same platform, same world.
